name: Spinach Ricotta Lasagna

components.name: Spinach Ricotta Lasagna
steps: Preheat oven to 190 C. Heat oil in a skillet and soften onions and garlic; stir in tomato passata and dried herbs, simmer 10 minutes.
Wilt spinach, cool enough to handle and squeeze out excess water; mix spinach with ricotta, egg and a pinch of nutmeg.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce across the base of a large baking dish.
Layer dry lasagna sheets, spinach ricotta filling and tomato sauce repeatedly, finishing with sauce and shredded mozzarella and hard cheese.
Cover with foil and bake about 30 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more until golden and lasagna sheets fully tender.
Rest 15 minutes to cut six defined portions; chill quickly and freeze fully cooled portions if desired.

Reheat previously cooked leftovers to 74 C, stirring and checking the centre. For egg dishes, ensure eggs are completely set before portioning.
Cool cooked rice rapidly and keep refrigerated; avoid leaving rice at room temperature. Reheat rice thoroughly once.
Defrost frozen portions in the refrigerator. Re-crisp pastries, breaded vegetables and air-fried items in an oven or air fryer.
Keep delicate avocado, fresh salad, cold yogurt sauce and unbaked crisp toppings separate. They are generally not freezer-friendly.
